'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Tom Hollingsworth DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingsworth]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Sheet title Cor Sops / Car Sos. Hunt Down dueling.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Hollingsworth]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
